Flight · Romania

Aerial target spends eight minutes in Romanian airspace northeast of Sulina

14 October 2026 · Northeast of Sulina · 17:38 incursion

Radar-confirmed incursion; UAV identification and operator unresolved

Romanian radar tracked an unidentified target entering national airspace at 17:38 on 14 October 2026, about 22 km northeast of Sulina over territorial waters. It departed at 17:46.

Two Romanian F-16s launched and a RO-Alert was issued at 17:39. The air alert ended at 19:03. No weapons engagement, shoot-down, damage or casualties were reported.

This is a separate afternoon incursion. The official statement establishes the crossing and duration, while identification as a UAV, its model and operator remain unresolved.
